howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Six stages, each with its own timeline and owner. You always know which one you are in.

quote.title: 1 · Firm quote
quote.body: You pick the vehicle and we hand you the landed cost with plates, itemised line by line with the legal basis of every tax.

purchase.title: 2 · Purchase at origin
purchase.body: We buy the unit at auction, wholesale or dealership and move it to the port of loading.

shipping.title: 3 · Ocean transit
shipping.body: A 40' HC container shared across several units, which splits the freight. Marine insurance included.

customs.title: 4 · Customs clearance
customs.body: Import declaration, tax assessment and release, handled with our customs broker.

registration.title: 5 · Registration
registration.body: RUNT registration, plates and mandatory insurance. The vehicle is road legal.

delivery.title: 6 · Delivery
delivery.body: We deliver the vehicle with its full documentation in the city you choose.

guarantees.noSurprise: The quoted price is the price. If a tax rises after we issue it, we absorb the difference within its validity period.
guarantees.traceable: Every cost line cites its regulation. You can verify it yourself.
guarantees.tracked: Live tracking from purchase to delivery, with a traffic light per stage.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: A foreign-trade and technology team, obsessed with making the final figure the final figure.
about.body: Importing a vehicle into Colombia is expensive and opaque. Most intermediaries quote the price at origin and leave the taxes “to be confirmed”, which is exactly where the surprise appears. We build the full calculation before you sign: duty, VAT and excise on their correct bases, the real freight for the route, port costs, registration and plates.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask us most before buying.

q1.q: Does the catalogue price include taxes?
q1.a: Yes. The price you see is the landed cost in Colombia with plates: it includes duty, VAT, excise where applicable, freight, insurance, port costs, customs clearance and registration.

q2.q: How long does the process take?
q2.a: Between 60 and 90 business days depending on origin. Ocean transit is the longest stage: 22 days from Los Angeles and up to 40 from Shanghai.

q3.q: Why does an electric vehicle pay less tax?
q3.a: Electric vehicles carry 0 % duty, 5 % VAT and are excluded from excise tax. On a petrol vehicle those three taxes can exceed 40 % of the customs value.

q4.q: What happens if the exchange rate moves?
q4.a: The quote fixes that day's rate and its validity window. Taxes are assessed using the rate of the last business day of the week before the declaration, as the regulation requires.

q5.q: Can I import a used vehicle?
q5.a: Colombia heavily restricts used-vehicle imports. We check each unit's eligibility before offering it and tell you if it is blocked.

q6.a: The quoted price holds for its validity period. You also track your vehicle live from the portal, stage by stage.
